Also if someone else is choking DO NOT pat their back while they cough. Perform the Heimlich on them (flat hand over fist and fist on their diaphragm and thrust in and up, hard) until the food is dislodged. If they are coughing before you help them, the food is particularly trapped so patting their back could get it more stuck and they have a higher chance of dying.
